items.why: Pivotal raised its price target to $930 from $790 and kept a Buy rating, citing early Muse adoption and the new Muse Wonder models.
BofA flagged shorter iPhone 18 Pro wait times ahead of pre-order shipments, and Apple rallied with Meta near buy points while chip names led lower.
Microsoft kept gaining after saying it is rolling out new AI chips to reduce dependence on Nvidia chips, a move that lifted shares Monday.
Bitcoin bounced after dipping below $81,000 overnight, recovering above $83,000 as shorts were forced out ahead of Wednesday CPI.

market_note: Bank earnings from JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and Citigroup are due today, with CPI due Wednesday.
summary: Stocks are mixed early, with the Dow holding up on strong bank earnings while tech and chips lag. Big cap AI winners are offsetting the chip selloff.
